title: Slice rank of tensor subspaces over any field is bounded by (d/2+1) times its rank over the algebraic closure
difficulty: The result requires one common slice span for an entire tensor subspace, rather than separate low-rank decompositions of individual elements. The author builds a paired-block tensor and proves the reverse equality by a prime-ideal/Nullstellensatz evaluation and matrix-rank contradiction. The separately stated Derksen descent inequality closes the argument only after that complete new encoding is established.
